html:
G'oya

started_at <= t AND ended_at > t shartida ikkita oraliq bor, va oddiy indeks ulardan faqat bittasini toraytiradi. started_at indeksi "t dan oldin boshlangan smenalar"ni beradi, lekin ular minglab: oxirgi savdo uchun deyarli hamma smena. Har biri uchun ended_at ni tekshirish kerak bo'ladi.

Smenalar kesishmaydi, shuning uchun savdo faqat t dan oldin boshlangan eng oxirgi smenaga tegishli bo'lishi mumkin. Uni indeks bir qadamda topadi (ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1). Keyin faqat shu bitta smena hali tugamaganini tekshirish qoladi.

Yechim

WITH c AS (
  SELECT x.id, x.amount, x.sold_at,
         (SELECT s.id
          FROM shifts s
          WHERE s.started_at <= x.sold_at
          ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
          LIMIT 1) AS shift_id
  FROM sales x
)
SELECT c.id, c.amount, s.worker
FROM c
LEFT JOIN shifts s ON s.id = c.shift_id AND s.ended_at > c.sold_at

CTE har bir savdoga nomzod smenani topadi. LEFT JOIN ning ON qismida ikkita shart: smena aynan o'sha nomzod va u savdo paytida hali tugamagan. Ikkinchi shart bajarilmasa, savdo tanaffusda bo'lgan va worker NULL qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

Shartning o'zini yozish to'g'ri natija beradi, lekin har bir savdo uchun yarim jadval o'qiladi:

SELECT x.id, x.amount,
       (SELECT s.worker
        FROM shifts s
        WHERE s.started_at <= x.sold_at
          AND s.ended_at > x.sold_at) AS worker
FROM sales x

Faqat oxirgi boshlangan smenani olib, uning tugashini tekshirmaslik tanaffusdagi savdoni oldingi kassirga yozib qo'yadi. Namunada 21:15 dagi savdo Jasurning smenasi tugagandan keyin bo'lgan.
